messages:
Priya: Heads up — Support ticket flagged a stale search snippet showing an old batching default and a shortlink that 404s. Found via internal search result for `runtime batching`.
Ben: Thanks. Can you paste the exact snippet + the link that 404s?
Priya: Sure — snippet returned by search index: 
```
Default batching=512; see /short/old-batching
```
Link in result points to `/short/old-batching` which returns 404 in staging.
Sam: I can take this. Quick plan: replace shortlink with canonical `/docs/runtime/batching` and update frontmatter owner if missing. Will open a tiny PR today.
Marta: Assign to @Sam and ping @docs-team for review. Also check i18n — that shortlink might be referenced in localized pages.
Sam: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 (small sed + frontmatter add). Diff summary in PR description.
Alex: Quick question — does this also show up on Dedicated onboarding guide? I remember the old shortlink was copied across a few guides.
Priya: Yup — one mention left in `/guides/dedicated/quickstart.md` line ~72.
Ben: @docs-team please triage — if it's small we can include in the next docs deploy today. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: Patch includes this command for find+replace (devs can run locally to verify):
```
# run in repo root
grep -rl "short/old-batching" docs/ | xargs sed -i 's|short/old-batching|/docs/runtime/batching|g'
```
Also updates frontmatter: `owner: "platform-docs"` where missing.
Marta: Nice. Can you also add a short note in the PR about search reindexing / releasetime so support knows when the search result will refresh?
Sam: Added note: "Search index rebuild scheduled after merge; results may take ~15-30m to reflect." Created PR comment with repro steps and the failing ticket #4821.
Ben: Congrats small PR, big impact. :tada: Can one of you confirm staging deploy and that the 404 disappears from search results?
deploy-bot: Deployment to `docs-staging` queued by CI; will post status here.
Sam: Merged to main and triggered docs deploy. Monitor: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/4821
Sam: Confirmed staging shows canonical link; search snippet updated locally. Will watch for index refresh and ping support when it's live. :thumbsup:
Priya: Thanks all. Assigning follow-up to @docs-team to double-check translations and legacy shortlink redirects in CDN mapping.
Ben: Closing this thread once support confirms ticket resolved. Good catch, Priya.
